question.prompt: When \(0.000315\) is multiplied by \(7{,}928{,}564\) the product is closest to which of the following?

solutions.explanation: Use nearby easy numbers to trap the product in a short interval. Both factors are positive, and \[ 0.0003<0.000315<0.00032, \] \[ 7{,}900{,}000<7{,}928{,}564<8{,}000{,}000. \] Multiplying the two lower bounds gives a smaller product, and multiplying the two upper bounds gives a larger product. solutions.title: Bound the product with easy numbers
